data.narrative: Multiple transactions structured below $10,000 CTR threshold across high-risk channels and jurisdictions. Funds moved rapidly through interconnected accounts (ACC-10042, ACC-10088) linked to customer CUST-20015 (Viktor Petrov), associated with shell entity Petrov Trading LLC. External fraud databases confirm association with prior structuring and trade-based money laundering networks. Graph analysis reveals layering pattern through intermediary accounts and fan-out to offshore beneficiaries in Cyprus and UAE. Prior SAR filed (SAR-2026-00147) noted similar behavior. Accounts frozen and wire recall initiated for pending transaction.

Multiple transactions across linked accounts structured to avoid CTR reporting thresholds. Customer email matched 3 external fraud database reports including FinCEN 314(b) request and ACAMS trade-based laundering network. Prior SAR filed January 2026 for similar behavior. Account freeze and wire recall initiated. Enhanced due diligence previously conducted; customer flagged as high-risk with PEP and adverse media monitoring.
